answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 55 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a violet bet on surviving 55 epochs of grading, and every raven settlement recomputes the lotus schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
